verdict.rationale: Supabase auto-generates REST/GraphQL APIs from the DB schema, exposes a Management API/CLI for provisioning and config, and ships an official MCP server so AI agents can query/manage projects — evidenced by openapi.json, CLI docs/probe, and MCP handshake probe. However, community reports flag PostgREST/RLS limitations forcing developers back to custom API servers, and MCP access uses elevated service_role that bypasses RLS with unresolved auth issues, showing the API parity isn't fully seamless or safe for all UI-equivalent operations.
